send: date -Is; hostname   # this machine: the exe.dev VM
hostname; date -Is; echo "Slurm job $SLURM_JOB_ID step $SLURM_STEP_ID"; ls /dev/datadev* /dev/pcie_adc* /dev/tpr*
cd wt-b && git log -1 --format='HEAD %H (%D)%n     %s' && echo "local changes: $(git status --short | wc -l)"
git diff --quiet 25e6f4d -- psdaq/psdaq/control_gui && echo 'psdaq/psdaq/control_gui: unchanged vs base 25e6f4d'
(cd psdaq/psdaq/webgui/tests && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test_webgui_backend.py test_webgui_events_pva.py test_check_parity.py test_parity_enumerate_v1.py 2>&1 | tail -1)

daq_sim e2e -w $R/redo/out/b-e2e1 --events 1000  > $R/redo/out/b-e2e1.log 2>&1; echo E2E_EXIT=$?; grep -E '^20.* e2e: host|clicked .* reported|^  [0-9] (PASS|FAIL)|^E2E|truncate-xtc2:|kill-drp:' $R/redo/out/b-e2e1.log | cut -c1-400

daq_sim e2e -w $R/redo/out/b-e2e2 --events 1000  > $R/redo/out/b-e2e2.log 2>&1; echo E2E_EXIT=$?; grep -E '^20.* e2e: host|clicked .* reported|^  [0-9] (PASS|FAIL)|^E2E|truncate-xtc2:|kill-drp:' $R/redo/out/b-e2e2.log | cut -c1-400

daq_sim e2e -w $R/redo/out/b-kill --events 1000 --break kill-drp > $R/redo/out/b-kill.log 2>&1; echo E2E_EXIT=$?; grep -E '^20.* e2e: host|clicked .* reported|^  [0-9] (PASS|FAIL)|^E2E|truncate-xtc2:|kill-drp:' $R/redo/out/b-kill.log | cut -c1-400
